rabbi-avin-bar-chiyya.name: Rabbi Avin bar Ḥiyya
rabbi-avin-bar-chiyya.bio: Amora who asks Rabbi Avin bar Kahana about the offspring of a female designated as a guilt offering (Temurah 20b).
rabbi-avin-bar-chiyya.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a dark, neatly trimmed beard and a plain grey wool mantle, leaning forward with a raised finger as he poses a question; background of a lamplit study hall with low benches and scrolls on a shelf.

rabbi-avin-bar-kahana.name: Rabbi Avin bar Kahana
rabbi-avin-bar-kahana.bio: Amora who answers Rabbi Avin bar Ḥiyya’s question about the offspring of a female designated as a guilt offering (Temurah 20b–21a).
rabbi-avin-bar-kahana.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a greying beard and a brown wool mantle, seated with an open scroll on his knees and answering with a calm, open hand; background of a study hall courtyard in late afternoon light.
